ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 17 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Разум» (razum) is 'reason' throughout, including Laozi's opening line and the closing Silesius thought, where the website had 'mind'; Strakhov's «разумение (слово)» (razumenie (slovo), 'understanding (the word)') keeps the book's term and the lowercase. Pronouns for God are lowercase as in the Russian, and «Федор» (Fyodor) follows D0003.
